recentItems.description:

Starring Tanner Stine, Kristoffer Polaha, Evan Hofer, Kelsey Reinhardt, Mykelti Williamson, Mario Van Peebles, Frances Fisher.

recentItems.title: Possums (1998) | Full Movie | Mac Davis, Greg Coolidge, Cynthia Sikes, Andrew Prine
recentItems.description:
The Nowata, Oklahoma, high school football team has not scored a touchdown in 13 years. Despite that, Will (Mac Davis) loves announcing the games on the radio. But the rest of the town is not so upbeat, and votes to dissolve the team in order to make room for a discount store. Undaunted, Will remains on the air, broadcasting accounts of imagined games that his beloved Possums actually win. The townsfolk come together when outsiders begin to take an interest in the team's fictional victories.

Starring Mac Davis, Greg Coolidge, Cynthia Sikes, Andrew Prine.

recentItems.title: Draft Day (2014) | Full Movie | Kevin Costner, Jennifer Garner, Chadwick Boseman
recentItems.description:
At the NFL Draft, General Manager Sonny Weaver has the opportunity to rebuild his team when he trades for the number one pick. He must decide what he's willing to sacrifice on a life-changing day for a few hundred young men with NFL dreams.

Starring Kevin Costner, Jennifer Garner, Chadwick Boseman, Chi McBride, Terry Crews.

recentItems.title: Amber Alert (2024) | Full Movie | Hayden Panettiere, Tyler James Williams
recentItems.description:
An ordinary rideshare becomes a high-stakes game of cat and mouse when Jaq (Hayden Panettiere) and Shane (Tyler James Williams) receive an alert of a child abduction on their phones. Quickly realizing they are behind a car that matches the description of the kidnapper’s, Jaq and Shane desperately race against time to save the child’s life.

Starring Hayden Panettiere, Tyler James Williams, Kevin Dunn, Saidah Arrika Ekulona, Kurt Oberhaus, Katie McClellan.
